newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - General Scanning rated buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - General Scanning rated buy.

text.p: --Madison Securities Inc said Wednesday it started coverage of General Scanning Inc with a buy rating for the aggressive portion of investor portfolios.
--In a research report, the company estimates General Scanning's EPS at $0.67 for 1996 and $1.18 for 1997.

--General Scanning develops and manufactures a line of laser systems for a wide range of applications in the semiconductor, electronics, aircraft and medical fields. It also makes laser subsystems and thermal printers. This diversification, Madison said, should enable the company to withstand economic downturns.
